subject: Executive coverage playbook — aligning CIO/VP availability for product briefing
body:
From: James Park <j.park@novapower.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hernandez <t.hernandez@novapower.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — CIO-level time for Redwood demo next week

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the intro (Tom looped me in). We're excited to see the platform but my schedule is tight next week. Can we do a 30-minute CIO-level briefing where you run through performance, dedicated/private options, and high-level cost controls? Prefer Tue/Wed afternoon Pacific. If your VP can join for 10–15 minutes that'd be ideal.

If that doesn't work, happy to hand off to Tom (our product lead) but I'd like to personally attend if possible.

Best,
James
James Park
CIO, NovaPower
j.park@novapower.com

-----

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: James Park <j.park@novapower.com>
Cc: Tom Hernandez <t.hernandez@novapower.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — CIO-level time for Redwood demo next week

Hi James — really appreciate you looping us in. Laura (our VP of Sales Strategy) and I discussed cover options for short executive windows. Two proposals below — both keep the meeting to 30 minutes and reserve a 10-minute executive handoff/sponsor discussion. I've attached a short "exec coverage playbook" that outlines who's on deck and fallback options for last-minute conflicts.

Option A (preferred):
- Tue Jun 8, 3:30–4:00pm PT 
- Mateo runs the first 20 minutes (performance, routing/fallback behavior, cost levers)
- Laura joins 4:50–4:55? (typo: should be 3:50–3:55) for sponsor/contract questions and next steps

Option B (backup):
- Wed Jun 9, 2:00–2:30pm PT 
- Mateo + Laura as above; Tom (your product lead) can present the integration questions during the last 8 minutes if you need it

If neither works, I can put Marissa Cole (VP, Solutions) as the exec attendee — she has availability Wed afternoon and can speak to deployment guarantees and dedicated capacity.

Attachments: exec-coverage-playbook-v1.pdf, calendar-proposed-times.ics

Action items: James — pick A or B (or propose a specific time). Laura — can you confirm you can join for the sponsor 3:50–3:55 block? Marissa — FYI in case we need the alternate exec.

Thanks,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com

-----

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, James Park <j.park@novapower.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — CIO-level time for Redwood demo next week

Hey all — I can hold the 3:50–3:55 sponsor window on Tue Jun 8. I'll be on standby for any procurement/pricing questions. If Marissa needs to step in we'll coordinate a quick prep run (10 minutes) beforehand.

Marissa — can you block Wed Jun 9, 1:45–2:45pm PT as a contingency? That gives us a 15-minute buffer and a dry-run if we need to swap.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Strategy | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

-----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, James Park <j.park@novapower.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 12:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — CIO-level time for Redwood demo next week

Thanks — I can join Wed Jun 9 and cover the exec portion if that ends up being the only feasible slot. One small ask: if James can't get 30 straight minutes due to calendar fragmentation, we should reserve a 10-minute pre-brief for the exec attendee immediately before the meeting so they have the one-slide narrative and the SLOs/cost bullets. I've dropped a very short slide checklist into the playbook (exec coverage, page 2).

Also re: attachments — I'm going to add a one-page deployment FAQ to the playbook and resend v2 by EOD Thu. Mateo — feel free to send the invite to James once we confirm.

Marissa Cole
VP, Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

-----

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: James Park <j.park@novapower.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — CIO-level time for Redwood demo next week

James — great — thanks for the quick reply. You picked Option A. Locked: Tue Jun 8, 3:30–4:00pm PT. Calendar invite sent (link below).

Pre-brief: Tue Jun 8, 3:15–3:25pm PT (10-minute exec pre-brief for you and any delegates)
Host: Mateo Alvarez (demo), Sponsor block: Laura Bennett (3:50–3:55)
Alternate exec: Marissa Cole (on-call Wed Jun 9, 1:45–2:45pm PT)

Meeting link: https://redwood-inference.app/meetings/NP-0427/slot-confirm
DocuSign/Next steps: https://redwood-inference.app/deals/NP-0427/next-steps (placeholder)

Attachments included: exec-coverage-playbook-v1.pdf, calendar-proposed-times.ics

Thanks again — we'll keep the session tight and bring only the metrics + deployment guardrails so it's useful for a CIO-level review. Looking forward to it.

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com

---
Notes:
- Playbook contains: 1) sponsor roles & exact 2–3 sentence talking points for the exec, 2) fallback routing if exec is late, 3) a one-slide cost tradeoff summary, 4) post-demo mutual action plan template.
- Calendar invite and pre-brief are attached as an .ics and referenced link above.
